hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-light tracking-tighter leading-none

rules: Use Fraunces (refined editorial serif) for display and headings.
Use Inter for UI and body copy. Keep it restrained.
Typography outside the crystal must be used sparingly.
Use light weights for elegance and impact, avoiding default bolds.
Primary environment is warm ivory / near-white lavender.
NO giant gradients across sections. Color is introduced through crystal refraction, lighting, and controlled accents.
Each of the 4 industries in AI Factory gets a subtle color identity within the Calyza palette.

surfaces: Use 'Crystal Glass' for the header if sticky, requiring backdrop-blur-xl, border-white/20, and saturate-150.
Use sharp or maximally 8px border-radius for minimal, refined geometry.
shadows: Ambient, diffuse shadows only. Avoid harsh box-shadows.

rules: Navigation is minimal: Home, Services, AI Factory, Case Studies, Contact. CTA is 'Enter AI Factory'. Visually quiet.
Use extreme asymmetry and wide gaps (gap-8 to gap-12).
Allow substantial negative space, letting the central crystal dominate.
Ensure grid items are direct children of grid containers.

strategy: The entire homepage is built around a central interactive crystal.
Numbered manifesto chapters with one slow editorial marquee.
Scroll states: 01 pure crystal/origin, 02 expanding, 03 internal layers visible, 04 ecosystem structure emerges, 05 acceleration/capability emerges, 06 transforms toward AI Factory.

rules: Premium, scroll-driven crystal transformation is the primary motion.
Use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling.
AVOID particle explosions, excessive bloom, neon, and bouncing.

accessibility.contrast: Maintain APCA / WCAG AA minimum 4.5:1 for body text.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='enter-factory-btn').

implementation: Procedural geometry crystal. Circular overall form, faceted internal structure.
Transparent/translucent optical material, polished architectural finish, realistic depth, subtle refraction, premium studio lighting.
NOT rough quartz, NOT diamond jewelry, NOT star, NOT generic glowing sphere, NOT AI orb.
Lazy 3D initialization. Provide immediate CSS/SVG crystal fallback.
Pause rendering when offscreen for performance.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build an Awwwards Site-of-the-Day level experiential site.
Implement the crystal using React Three Fiber. Base it on a scroll-driven timeline.
Ensure the crystal transforms: expands like an atom, separates into layers, reveals internal geometry, smoothly and reversibly.
Organize narrative into chapters: ORIGIN, ECOSYSTEM, ACCELERATION, AI FACTORY.
AI Factory industries: Healthcare, FinTech, Education, Hospitality. (NO Manufacturing, NO Retail).
Tagline: 'AI Factory — Industry-ready intelligence, built to deploy.'
Never use generic AI/SaaS templates. No standard hero or repeated card grids.
Include a kinetic hero with signature on-load masked line-by-line reveal.
DO NOT use a transparent background in headers without blur. Apply Glassmorphism rules correctly.
DO NOT output placeholder text for images; use the provided Unsplash URLs.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Make creative, distinctive frontends.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions to specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
